new_value: render_post (messaging.py:249-252) strips client-supplied 'from' and rebinds it to request.remote.hostinfo, matching the request.remote.hostinfo peer-binding convention used by provisioning.py/edhoc.py/senml.py. Stored inbox (_inbox), sent (_sent) and detail records all carry the bound identity; GET /msg/inbox, GET /msg/sent, GET /msg/sent/{id} and Observe notifications expose it.
